bubble.moreanimation.face_overstretch.1: Ow, ow! You're twisting my face too far!
bubble.moreanimation.face_overstretch.2: Easy, Master! You're going to wrench my neck...
bubble.moreanimation.face_overstretch.3: Oww... please stop pulling my face that way!
bubble.moreanimation.face_overstretch.4: Master! That isn't how you're supposed to play with my face!
bubble.moreanimation.ear_overstretch.1: Ah! My ear hurts—please stop pulling!
bubble.moreanimation.ear_overstretch.2: Gently, Master! You're going to hurt my ear!
bubble.moreanimation.ear_overstretch.3: Ow... my ears are sensitive! Don't pull so hard!
bubble.moreanimation.ear_overstretch.4: Ow, ow, ow! Let go of my ear!
bubble.moreanimation.eye_poke.1: Ah! My eye! You can't poke there!
bubble.moreanimation.eye_poke.2: That hurts! Master, why would you poke my eye?!
bubble.moreanimation.eye_poke.3: Wah! I can barely open my eye now...
bubble.moreanimation.eye_poke.4: Master! You could really hurt me there!
bubble.moreanimation.tail_overstretch.1: Please don't pull so hard... my tail might break...
bubble.moreanimation.tail_overstretch.3: You're going to pull my tail off...
bubble.moreanimation.tail_overstretch.4: Ow... don't pull it any farther that way!
bubble.moreanimation.tail_overstretch.6: W-wait... that isn't how you play with a tail...
bubble.moreanimation.tail_overstretch.7: Please... it'll really break if you keep pulling...
moreanimation.dialogue.kick_butt.1: Ow! Master, why would you suddenly kick me there?!
moreanimation.dialogue.kick_butt.2: Ouch... that really hurt! You kicked way too hard, Master!
moreanimation.dialogue.kick_butt.3: Ow, ow, ow... that isn't somewhere you're supposed to kick!
moreanimation.dialogue.kick_butt.4: Master! Couldn't you at least warn me first? That really hurt!
moreanimation.dialogue.kick_butt.5: Ow... that kick wasn't gentle at all. You're so mean, Master...
moreanimation.dialogue.kick_butt.6: Aah! That hurt... are you teasing me on purpose, Master?!
moreanimation.dialogue.kick_butt.strange: Hey! What was that kick for?!
Ow! Why would you just walk up and kick me like that?!
Hey! Don't just kick me there!
moreanimation.dialogue.kick_launch.1: Aaaah—! Master, that kick was way too hard!
moreanimation.dialogue.kick_launch.2: Waaah—! I'm flying! How much force did you put into that, Master?!
moreanimation.dialogue.kick_launch.3: Ah! Wait, wait—You actually kicked me into the air!
moreanimation.dialogue.kick_launch.4: Master—! That hurt! At least warn me first!
moreanimation.dialogue.kick_launch.5: Sniff... that kick nearly sent this whole fox flying away for good...
moreanimation.dialogue.kick_launch.6: Aah—! Master, you really didn't hold back at all!
moreanimation.dialogue.kick_launch.stran: Aaah! How hard did you kick me?!
bubble.moreanimation.slap.1: Hey! Master, why did you suddenly slap me?!
bubble.moreanimation.slap.3: Ugh... my whole face is stinging!
